messages:
ashwin: quick check — onboarding zeta13b-v2. Where are the authoritative weights? HF origin or our s3 mirror?

maria: HF origin is hf://redwood/zeta13b-v2 (public). we pushed a mirror to s3://rw-artifacts/models/zeta13b/2024-05-08 for inference testing.

leo: bucket has a redwood-models-reader role. @ashwin if you haven't got read access ping iam-requests.

ashwin: I can read the manifest but CI fails on shard-3 checksum. HF manifest sha256=2b9f... but mirror shows 3b9f... small byte diff. :confused:

jessica: hmm tokenizer note — this model's tokenizer.json has pad_offset field set to 1 in HF but mirror's tokenizer.json still shows pad_offset:0. could that cause mismatch in our decode tests? :thinking_face:

ashwin: attaching small debug: ```bash
# from env-runner
aws s3 cp s3://rw-artifacts/models/zeta13b/weights/shard-3.bin - | sha256sum
3b9f2c...  -
# hf direct: curl -sL https://huggingface.co/redwood/zeta13b-v2/resolve/main/weights/shard-3.bin | sha256sum
2b9f2c...  -
```

maria: that looks like mirror got a failed multipart upload and last part truncated. i can re-run mirror job. will also include full manifest with size/sha256.

artifact-scan-bot: manifest-scan: detected checksum mismatch for path weights/shard-3.bin (s3://rw-artifacts/models/zeta13b/weights/shard-3.bin) — severity: warn.

leo: if you re-mirror, please use `aws s3 cp --only-show-errors` + validate size and sha256 after upload. we should also add object metadata x-amz-meta-sha256 to reduce blind checks.

jessica: also double-check tokenizer schema version. Our serving runtime expects tokenizer.json schema v2 (fields: vocab_size, pad_token_id, pad_offset). If mirror has v1, runtime fallback will re-tokenize and tests fail.

ashwin: noted. Maria, can you also dump tokenizer.json from HF and mirror and attach? i want to diff quickly.

maria: pasted diffs: 
HF tokenizer.json: {"vocab_size":50257,"pad_token_id":0,"pad_offset":1,"schema_version":"v2"}
S3 tokenizer.json: {"vocab_size":50257,"pad_token_id":0,"pad_offset":0,"schema_version":"v1"}

ashwin: that explains the unit test decode failures. i'll hold off on lint until mirror and tokenizer are in sync. thanks. :thumbsup:

leo: for config validation, run `registry lint --manifest s3://rw-artifacts/models/zeta13b/manifest.json` — it checks sha256, sizes, and tokenizer.schema_version. If lint passes, CI should be green.

maria: re-mirror started (job id: mirror-2024-05-08-42). ETA ~3m. will upload manifest with x-amz-meta-sha256 and schema tag.

artifact-scan-bot: upload-notice: mirror-2024-05-08-42 completed. triggered manifest-scan.

artifact-scan-bot: manifest-scan: all checks passed (sha256s match, tokenizer schema v2 present).

ashwin: re-ran CI smoke. all green now. thanks everyone. leaving note: add preflight check to mirror job: compute sha256 locally and set as object metadata.

jessica: filing a tiny follow-up PR to runtime to log tokenizer schema warnings in more detail. cc @leo

leo: good call. i'll add a quick runbook entry for mirror failures and a checklist for model onboarding (permissions, sha256, tokenizer schema).

maria: ok closing this thread — ping me if anything else breaks during canary. :wave:
